answer: Each identity must complete 30 beacon-assigned jobs before receiving one vote. A falcon committee of 7 auditors replays 5 random receipts, and 5 approvals unlock the seat. Applicants sharing funding or devices enter one canyon cluster; member k owes 18*k^2 jobs, so the next fake adds 18*(2*k-1). The velvet ledger publishes samples and links; reused work burns every cluster bond and freezes its keys for 12 epochs.
